entries.name: Kiln
entries.description: A dark workshop with the kiln door open a crack: a near-black ground, cream ink, Boska's cut high-contrast serif over a plain Geist, and heat only where something is hot.

theme.material: near-black ground, cream ink, Boska over Geist, smoked wells, photographs lit by the work, a heat ramp that marks temperature, one ember signal

entries.name: Loom
entries.description: A weaving studio speaking quietly: ecru paper, Caslon cut for display with a book's calm over a plain Hanken Grotesk, thin rules, and one deep indigo, the colour of dyed yarn, that arrives as a band or a button and never as a wash.

theme.material: ecru paper with sand steps, warm near-black ink, Libre Caslon Display heads and prices over Hanken Grotesk, thin rules and one ink rule, cloth photographed close in window light, one deep indigo

entries.name: Lumen
entries.description: A night console with a literary voice: a violet-black ground, near-white ink, Instrument Serif set all in lowercase and a step large over Geist, hairline wells and one molten brass signal.

theme.material: violet-black ground, near-white ink, lowercase Instrument Serif heads a step large over Geist and Geist Mono, hairline wells, a faint blueprint grid, one molten brass signal and one rose verb

entries.name: Manifesto
entries.description: A declaration printed on a dark sheet: a warm near-black ground, warm off-white ink, Anton capitals set as big as the width allows and leaded tight, a small plain Public Sans body, hairlines, one heavy ink bar, square edges and one fighting red.

theme.material: warm near-black ground, warm off-white ink, Anton capitals at poster size leaded tight over a quiet Public Sans body, hairlines, a heavy ink bar and square edges, one fighting red

entries.name: Midnight
entries.description: A cold, calm night instrument whose blue is the ground itself: deep midnight blue to every edge, cool white ink, Mona Sans at an expanded 300 for the heads like titles on a film, the same family at its normal width for reading, surfaces cut square in steps of lighter blue, one azure signal.

theme.material: midnight-blue ground to every edge, cool white ink, Mona Sans expanded at 300 over its normal width, square-cut surfaces in lightness steps, photographs as moonlight, one azure signal

entries.name: Newsprint
entries.description: A broadsheet in a browser: pale newsprint stock, warm black ink, a blunt Zilla Slab head over a calm Spectral book serif, hairlines and column rules for ordinary breaks, a double rule for the major ones, and a dried-brick signal that never fills anything.

theme.material: pale newsprint stock, warm black ink, Zilla Slab heads over a Spectral body with Libre Franklin agate for listed figures, justified columns under hairline column rules, a double rule, one dried-brick signal

entries.name: Overprint
entries.description: A two-colour screenprint on cheap stock: grey newsprint, near-black ink, wide heavy Anybody capitals over a plain Archivo body, and two transparent flat inks, teal and orange, that print a deep moss where they cross.

theme.material: grey newsprint stock, near-black ink, wide heavy Anybody capitals over Archivo, flat square fills, a teal pass and an orange pass that print moss where they cross, photographs pulled through one pass

entries.name: Paste-up
entries.description: A hand-made flyer: kraft board, near-black toner, League Gothic capitals at poster size over a Newsreader galley, white copy paper on real paper shadows, controls on hard ink offsets, one sheet of fluorescent yellow.

theme.material: kraft board, a fibre wash, near-black toner, League Gothic capitals over a Newsreader galley, white copy paper on paper lifts, hard ink offsets, one sheet of fluorescent yellow

entries.name: Piste
entries.description: A mountain morning in print: snow-white paper, cold near-black ink, Barlow Condensed 800 in capitals for every head and figure, square edges on 2px ink rules, and one cobalt doing all the colour work, from the primary control to a full field.

theme.material: snow-white paper, cold near-black ink, Barlow Condensed 800 caps over Barlow, square edges on 2px ink rules, one cobalt for signal and field

entries.name: Refract
entries.description: White plaster in strong sun, with light doing the decorating: a net of water caustics moving across the ground, or a prism throwing a spectrum and its bright cusps over the page.

theme.material: sunlit white plaster with real light falling across it, water caustics or prism dispersion rendered live, deep pool-blue ink, Funnel Display at a light weight over Funnel Sans, clear surfaces that cast tinted shadows, one water signal

entries.name: Ribbon
entries.description: The hour before sleep, set quietly: Instrument Sans at 400, upright and tightly set, for every head, Figtree in a soft grey for reading, hairline rules instead of boxes, and the night itself drawn as slow light behind a machined instrument that really sets the levels.

theme.material: warm off-white or blue-black night, Instrument Sans at a quiet weight over Figtree, machined parts lit from above, the hour drawn as light on a generated canvas, one signal
theme.pictured: Night Notes, Stage hero, in the two-in-the-morning colourway

entries.name: Rim
entries.description: An instrument at night: warm black paper, warm off-white ink, Switzer at a medium weight for every head, Geist Mono for every number that measures something, square surfaces parted by hairlines, an orange signal and a sky-blue second, and the earth shown the way an instrument sees it, from straight above.

theme.material: warm black paper, warm off-white ink, Switzer 500 with Geist Mono for every measurement, square hairline surfaces, the earth photographed straight down, an orange signal and a sky-blue second

entries.name: Riso
entries.description: A small-press run from two drums and nothing else: bright uncoated stock, a medium blue drum that sets every word and a fluorescent pink drum for the fills, crossing in a purple nobody mixed.

theme.material: bright uncoated stock and no black, a medium blue drum for every word, a fluorescent pink drum for the fills, purple where they cross, Cabinet Grotesk 800 over Literata, grain, one word a hair out of register

entries.name: Solstice
entries.description: An almanac's warmth: cream paper, warm brown ink, Yeseva One heads, Archivo for the reading and Archivo Narrow for the small print, gold hairlines doing the ruling, square surfaces on hard paper shadows, photographs taken in low late light, and one vermilion signal.

theme.material: cream paper, warm brown ink, Yeseva One over Archivo and Archivo Narrow, gold hairlines and hard paper shadows, photographs in low warm light, one vermilion signal

entries.name: Specimen
entries.description: A foundry's material: warm oat paper, warm near-black ink, Bodoni Moda 400 pinned at its highest optical size so the hairlines thin to a razor against the stems, a Geist body beneath it, square 1px rules and one ink-blue signal.

theme.material: warm oat paper, warm near-black ink, razor-hairline Bodoni Moda over Geist, square 1px rules, one ink-blue signal that also draws the metric guides

entries.name: Spore
entries.description: A cellar at night: coffee-ground black warmed toward brown, a warm grain on its wells, parchment Young Serif over Instrument Sans, soft pills, photographs lit only by lamps and candles, and one oyster-mushroom pink.

theme.material: coffee-ground black with a warm grain, parchment ink, Young Serif over Instrument Sans, soft pills and grained wells, photographs lit by lamps and candles, one oyster pink

entries.name: Sport
entries.description: A results-sheet material: cool concrete paper, blue-black ink, Saira Condensed 800 in capitals over an Albert Sans body, big condensed figures and JetBrains Mono times, hairlines and one heavier bar rule, and volt as the only colour.

theme.material: cool concrete paper, blue-black ink, uppercase Saira Condensed over Albert Sans, condensed figures and mono times, two-weight rules, one volt fill

entries.name: Squeeze
entries.description: A market stall in colour: a forest-green ground with real chroma, warm white ink, Gabarito's round, heavy heads and figures over a sturdy Manrope, soft tiles a step lighter or deeper, fruit photographed bright and close, juicy peach controls and one warm-white card.

theme.material: forest-green paper with real chroma, warm white ink, Gabarito 800 heads and figures over Manrope, soft rounded tiles a step lighter or deeper, fruit photographed bright and close, juicy peach controls

entries.name: Sticker
entries.description: A print shop's material: a warm off-white sheet, warm black ink, Bowlby One SC capitals over Sofia Sans, hot pink and lime fills, every raised surface edged in a thick white die-cut on a hard offset shadow.

theme.material: warm off-white paper, warm black ink, Bowlby One SC over Sofia Sans, white die-cut borders on hard offset shadows, hot pink, lime and ink fills set with type

entries.name: Studio
entries.description: A design studio's proof sheet, caught mid-build: cool studio-white paper with an ink dot grid and a fine grain, blue-black ink, Hedvig Letters Serif for the heads (a contemporary serif with a calligraphic hand in its joins), a clean Geist body, crop marks at the corners of every printed piece, and one cadmium orange that both fills the action and draws the construction: metric guides, clear-space boxes, redlines.

theme.material: cool studio-white proof paper with an ink dot grid and grain, blue-black ink, Hedvig Letters Serif heads over Geist, crop marks on every printed piece, orange construction guides, the work photographed in true colour, one cadmium-orange signal

entries.name: Terminal
entries.description: The page is the terminal surface, and its pictures are printed in type.

theme.material: a near-black ground with a green cast in three lightness steps, pale phosphor ink and one bright phosphor signal with a dim wash of itself, every glyph Martian Mono with heads wide and text narrow, and pictures printed in the page's own glyphs: a photograph rendered as a grid of characters taken from the product's own text, dim cells small, bright cells full, stirred by the cursor

entries.name: Terrazzo
entries.description: A materials library's specification voice: off-white paper, near-black ink, wide Syne heads over a plain Onest body, JetBrains Mono for the codes and the millimetres, and white card surfaces ruled in 2px ink over a hard offset, holding the surfaces themselves photographed flat-on and close.

theme.material: off-white paper, white card surfaces ruled in ink over a hard offset, wide Syne heads over Onest, JetBrains Mono for codes and millimetres, surfaces photographed flat-on in true colour, rust the one signal

entries.name: Ultraviolet
entries.description: A producer's tool in one pigment: a paper tinted the same hue as the ink, one saturated violet in two strengths, Outfit set lowercase on every head and control, pills throughout, depth held to a hairline, photographs pulled into the violet.

theme.material: lavender paper or a violet-black night, Outfit set lowercase over Onest, hairline pills, one saturated violet in two strengths, photographs pulled into the violet
theme.pictured: Workbench, Stage hero, in the night colourway

entries.name: Vantage
entries.description: Reality capture at night: the thing itself, a site, a ridge, an object, rendered as tens of thousands of measured points on a blue-black ground, turning slowly while a sweep passes through and lights them.

theme.material: blue-black ground, a live point cloud of the real thing as the hero's light, a sweep that lights it, pale steel ink, Geologica with sharpened corners at a light weight, hairline frames with corner ticks, one lime signal for what was found

entries.name: Vellum
entries.description: An old printing house: a parchment ground, umber ink, Grenze Gotisch for the heads, its roman sibling Grenze for a sentence set large, a plain Hanken Grotesk for everything read, hairlines and double rules, and ultramarine as the one pigment.

theme.material: parchment paper, a long tan fibre wash on bands, umber ink, Grenze Gotisch heads over Hanken Grotesk with Grenze roman for statements, hairline and double rules, one ultramarine pigment

entries.name: Wayfind
entries.description: Public signage set as a page: cool grey paper, blue-black ink, every glyph in Chivo Mono (a sober grotesk cut to the fixed cell of a departure board), square 2px ink borders, ink plates that carry a sign, cobalt for what is live and amber for figures.

theme.material: cool grey paper, blue-black ink, Chivo Mono throughout, square 2px ink borders, ink plates, cobalt for what is live, amber for figures on ink

entries.name: Werkstatt
entries.description: A design school's printed prospectus: a warm putty ground, near-black ink, heavy Jost capitals over a plain Karla body, square 2px and 3px ink rules, and three flat primaries, blue, red and yellow, each with one job.

theme.material: warm putty ground with a lighter well, near-black ink, Jost 700 capitals and numerals over Karla, square 2px and 3px ink rules that box cells, flat ultramarine, vermilion and yellow primaries

entries.name: 企业级 BI 工作台
entries.description: 浅色、高信息密度的企业级 BI 工作台，用于经营分析和数据看板，覆盖 KPI、趋势、明细表和待办。
